description: Header file defining a templated class 'batched_dispatch_queue' that batches values and dispatches them via a task executor, including queue management, stopping mechanism, and batch processing logic.

classes.name: batched_dispatch_queue
classes.description: A templated class that batches pushed values and forwards them in batches to a callback via a task executor, with mechanisms for stopping and queue management.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the queue processing, drains remaining values.

methods.name: try_push
methods.description: Attempts to enqueue a value; dispatches a dequeue task if queue transitions from empty to non-empty.

methods.name: size_approx
methods.description: Returns an approximate size of enqueued values.

methods.name: handle_enqueued_values
methods.description: Processes and batches enqueued values, dispatching them via callback.

methods.name: dispatch_value_dequeue_task
methods.description: Dispatches a task to dequeue and process values.

methods.name: drain_queue
methods.description: Drains all remaining values in the queue, used during stop.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Helper function to block and attempt to pop a value from the queue with timeout.
